readings.summary: Add a parameterless GeneratedMessagePackFormatter attribute that fills a bodyless partial IMessagePackFormatter<T> implementation, using public contractless members by default and honoring any MessagePack attributes already present on T.
readings.code_difference: The attribute needs no configuration surface, and the generator only needs to select the existing contractless-or-attributed member model for T rather than supporting a surrogate metadata type.

readings.summary: Provide the same generated formatter capability but also support the proposed SurrogateType option so property keys, Union settings, and related metadata can come from a Project B surrogate whose properties map to T by name.
readings.code_difference: The attribute must expose a Type-valued SurrogateType property, and the generator must resolve and validate surrogate members and attributes, map them by property name to T, and generate serialization behavior from that mapped model.

data.quote: AArnott suggested a surrogate-type design: `[GeneratedMessagePackFormatter(SurrogateType = typeof(ProjectASurrogate))]`, keys mapped by property name; reporter: "Looks good." No design was settled in the thread.
